reviewScope: Individual review of all 300 original revision A training rows, including each question's answerability, complete exact source evidence or insufficiency, and a single useful grounded next question.
reviewMethod: Read every context and all three tasks in five batches of 20 contexts. Independently assessed each question against its complete source and next question. Reported 11 context-level findings to the author without editing training data. Re-read all 11 corrected contexts (33 rows), then checked evidence/anchor/question structure across all final rows. Row notes record individual semantic judgments, not generated test verdicts.
isolation: Did not read development or final evaluation modules, model outputs, other review results, or revision B training data.
limitations: Sources are fictional; review assesses internal consistency and question-specific grounding, not historical or empirical truth.
Grades 6-8 labels are author estimates and remain unvalidated.
Reviewer is an independent AI agent, not a human educator. Pedagogical effectiveness and grade suitability require educator review.
Passing this content audit does not establish trained-model behavior or downstream acceptance.
